_note: v4 investigation sequences. 'built': true when the sequence exists in the game; Danny only hints about built ones. Hints are plain spoken English.

puzzles.name: Walk the Room
hints: Before anything gets moved, Chief, check every way in or out of that office: the door bolt, the window, the stove pipe, the ceiling, the floor vent and the floor itself. Mark each one possible or impossible.

Try the bolt with a bit of thread, look at the window bars and the stove pipe, and knock on the floor. Only one of those six could let a person through. Use your camera plates on the things that matter: the body, the desk, the bolt, the note.
The door bolt, the window, the stove pipe, the ceiling and the vent are all impossible. The floor is the only one you should mark possible.

puzzles.name: The Body
puzzles.mechanic: Guided examination with an unreliable narrator
hints: Doctor Lindqvist will talk you through the body, Chief, but watch what he skips. Look at everything yourself.
Heart failure doesn't turn skin pink or leave a smell on the breath. Check the skin, the settled blood and the mouth.
The three things that don't fit a heart attack: the cherry-pink settled blood, the faint bitter-almond smell at the mouth, and the pink colour of his skin and nails.

puzzles.name: Time of Death
puzzles.mechanic: Cooling calculation with a sliding window
hints: Bodies cool at roughly one and a half degrees an hour, Chief. Work backwards from the thermometer reading.
Normal is 98.6. Take away the reading, divide by 1.5, and count back from the time you took it. Then check the stiffness and the settled blood agree.
He was 85.0 at seven o'clock: that's about nine hours of cooling, so around ten to ten last night. Set the window from half past nine to quarter past ten.

puzzles.name: The Bench Test
puzzles.mechanic: Six drops, four samples, three reagents
hints: Six drops of test chemical, four samples, Chief. Don't waste drops before you know what each chemical shows.
You need the chart that says which chemical reacts to what. Ask the doctor nicely, use my reference book, or force the kit open.
Put chemical B on the decanter brandy and on the glass: deep blue means cyanide. The heart drops go brown with C, but that's only his medicine.

puzzles.name: The Safe
hints: Pryce loved riddles. The combination is three numbers, and the answers are on the office walls and in his pocket.

'Her years' is the age written under the girl in the photograph, 'the wings' hearts' is the number of engines on the plane in the picture, and 'the minute the sky stopped' is on his stopped pocket watch.
Nineteen, three, seventeen: left to nineteen, right to three, left to seventeen.

puzzles.name: The Floor, the Box and the Latch
puzzles.mechanic: Knock and listen, then play back the tune
hints: Knock on the floor, Chief, and listen. Then listen to that music box all the way through.
The hollow spot is under the rug. The music box has numbered teeth, and the bookshelf has eight pull-books. Each note of the tune is a book.
Pull the books in this order: five, three, one, three, five, eight, five, three.

puzzles.name: Raking Light
puzzles.mechanic: Read charred paper with a lamp
